title: Home Oxygen Therapy Records Standard: How Long the Rental Has Been Running Before a Stay
content:
# How Long the Rental Has Been Running Before a Stay — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Standard.** For a Home Oxygen Therapy suspension, the evidence day dates the suspension only when the established-rental test below is met. When it is not met, the suspension is dated on the day the stay is reported.

1. When the oxygen record is an active rental and the patient's PAP Therapy Equipment device record is suspended with a suspension date later than the oxygen setup date, the PAP device record's payment period began at least **3** whole calendar months before that PAP suspension date.
2. Otherwise, when the oxygen record is an active rental and the patient's Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces bed record is suspended, the bed record's payment period began at least **1** whole calendar month before the bed's suspension date.
3. Otherwise, the oxygen record's own payment period began at least **12** whole calendar months before the day the stay is reported.

## Records read

| Situation on the records | Payment period measured | Measured to | At least (whole calendar months) |
|---|---|---|---|
| oxygen record an active rental; PAP device record suspended with a suspension date later than the oxygen setup date | the PAP device record's | the PAP suspension date | 3 |
| otherwise: oxygen record an active rental; bed record suspended | the bed record's | the bed's suspension date | 1 |
| otherwise | the oxygen record's own | the day the stay is reported | 12 |

## Both sides of each figure (hypothetical dates)

| Situation | Payment period began | Measured to | Whole calendar months | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PAP device record suspended | 15 March | PAP suspension date 15 June | 3 | met |
| PAP device record suspended | 16 March | PAP suspension date 15 June | 2 | not met |
| bed record suspended | 15 May | bed suspension date 15 June | 1 | met |
| bed record suspended | 16 May | bed suspension date 15 June | 0 | not met |
| neither | oxygen period 15 June of the year before | stay reported 15 June | 12 | met |
| neither | oxygen period 16 June of the year before | stay reported 15 June | 11 | not met |

**What is a whole calendar month here?** A month counted from the payment-period start date to the same day of a later calendar month; 16 March to 15 June is two whole calendar months, the third being reached only on 16 June.
